REQUIREMENTS
Applicant must show proof of downtown St. Petersburg, FL residency, within one of the City’s defined and
designated residential parking zones, by providing to the Transportation and Parking Management Department
a current Florida Driver’s License and current Florida Vehicle Registration, both in the applicant’s name and
with a downtown residence address located in one of the Residential Parking Zones.

REQUIREMENTS
By signing this application, I am attesting the above information to be true and correct and understand
any false information may be cause for my Residential Parking Permit and Visitor Parking Permits to be
revoked. I have received a copy of and agree to abide by the Residential Parking Permit Rules and
Regulations. The Transportation and Parking Management Department reserves the right to verify the
information provided above and to issue one Residential Parking Permit and three Visitor Parking Permits
per household based on the information provided.
